content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":true,"reason":"Aviation aftermarket business: engine and component repair, overhaul and parts for airlines and lessors, though it adds military shelters."},{"label":"C2","good":true,"reason":"Same niche: trading, leasing and repairing aircraft engines and selling used serviceable parts to airlines and lessors."},{"label":"C3","good":false,"reason":"Casino management is unrelated; its aviation work is business jet modification, not engine leasing or parts."},{"label":"C4","good":false,"reason":"Online auctions of salvage vehicles for insurers and dealers; no aircraft engine leasing, repair or parts business."},{"label":"C5","good":false,"reason":"Diversified industrial valves, pumps and composite panels; aerospace parts are a minor line, not engine leasing or MRO."},{"label":"C6","good":false,"reason":"In-flight connectivity and internet service plans; it shares the aviation customer base but not the engine business."},{"label":"C7","good":false,"reason":"Designs and certifies avionics such as flight displays and autopilots, not engines, leasing or engine repair."},{"label":"C8","good":false,"reason":"Industrial pumps, valves, brake pads and connectors; aerospace is a minor end market and no engine leasing."},{"label":"C9","good":false,"reason":"Rents natural gas compressors to oil and gas producers; the rental-plus-service model is similar but the equipment and industry differ."},{"label":"C10","good":false,"reason":"Manufactures industrial engines and generator sets for equipment makers; it does not lease engines or serve aviation."}]}
